text:
Marie Chen: Customer Nimbus asks to onboard Ceres-13B (fp16 and int8) into Private (VPC) for low-latency inference. Wants 99th <80ms at ~1k RPS baseline. Need quant experiments + eval on their prompt set. Ticket #C-5123
Samir Patel: Adding to eng-ml triage. @Leo Kim can you take quant lead? Also need runtime/kernel compatibility check.
Leo Kim: I can take quant. Quick checklist I need: model format (hf/ggml/pt), attention type, max seq, tokenizer files, and a sample prompt set. Any custom ops?
Marie Chen: We have weights uploaded to s3: s3://nimbus-uploads/ceres13b/{fp16,int8}/. Customer notes RoPE-style positional embeddings + a custom BPE tokenizer. Eval suite attached in the ticket (small, ~300 prompts).
Evan (cust-Nimbus): Yes — uploaded eval scripts and a few failing examples. Main issues: hallucinations on policy Qs, and some reproducibility variance. Deterministic mode preferred.
Ana Lopez: From Solutions side: timeline ask is 3 weeks to prod. Recommend smoke int8 and fp16, run eval, then canary on Dedicated. @Samir is that realistic?
Samir Patel: :thumbsup: Proposed plan: 1) runtime compatibility check 2) quant smoke (int8 + fp16 perf/quality) 3) run customer's eval + our regression set 4) perf bench (latency/throughput) 5) canary rollout w/ fallback. Estimate 8-12 engineer-days.
Leo Kim: Starting model scan now. Running a quick check command: ```runtimectl check-model --s3 s3://nimbus-uploads/ceres13b/fp16 --report /tmp/ceres-check.json``` Will post results in ~30m.
onboarding-bot: New intake created: RID-ceres-1718200123, owner=Leo Kim, SLA target: 2024-05-05.
Leo Kim: Scan results: attention type flagged as "Llama-like" but uses RoPE params; missing our rotary shim. Tokenizer vocab size mismatch (customer: 50400, platform default: 50272). Also flagged: custom layernorm epsilon=1e-5 (ok) and fused attention kernel mismatch on Ampere.
Marie Chen: Got it. @Evan can you share 5-10 representative prompts that trigger hallucinations so we can prioritize eval checks? Also confirm Dedicated canary is acceptable.
Evan (cust-Nimbus): Dedicated canary ok. I'll DM sample prompts and the problematic outputs.
Samir Patel: Action items: Leo to prototype quant smoke + rotary shim, Samir to provision Dedicated canary and perf harness, Ana to coordinate docs & customer comms. I'll open GH tracking issue and assign owners.
Ana Lopez: Noted. I'll draft customer-facing plan today and sync with legal for token logging rules.
Leo Kim: Quick note: quant smoke plan — run int8 static quant with 128-token sequences, compare perplexity / EM on the 300 prompts, iterate kernel mapping. If tokenizer conv needed, we should script: ```python tools/convert_tokenizer.py --in s3://nimbus-uploads/ceres13b/tokenizer.json --out /opt/tokenizers/ceres-50272.json```
Marie Chen: Thanks everyone. I'll update the ticket with the intake summary and expected milestones. :white_check_mark:
Samir Patel: Will follow up in GH and ping when canary infra is ready.
